tools.name: frame_extract
tools.description: Extract timestamped JPEG frames from a video or animated image. Time sampling supports evenly spaced frames (default), interval in seconds, or explicit times. mode=changes scans downscaled frames with local ffmpeg and returns the strongest visual changes, subject to threshold, scanFps and minGapSec. Change scores measure visual differences; they do not identify semantic events. Frames are returned chronologically. Use frame_search for text-to-frame semantic retrieval.

source.description: Video or animated image: an absolute path, a path relative to the bot workspace, or a log:/mem: handle.

mode.description: time (default) samples by time; changes selects visual changes without a model.

frames.description: Evenly spaced frame count, or maximum results in changes mode. Omit for the configured default. Do not combine with interval or times.

interval.description: Seconds between frames, starting at start; do not combine with frames or times.

times.description: Comma-separated timestamps in seconds, e.g. "0.5, 2, 4.25"; do not combine with frames, interval, start or end.

start.description: Range start in seconds, including changes mode. Cannot combine with times. Default 0.

end.description: Range end in seconds, including changes mode. Cannot combine with times. Default the clip duration.

threshold.description: Changes mode only: ffmpeg scdet threshold in percent, default 8. Lower values include smaller changes.

scanFps.description: Changes mode only: analysis frames per second, default 2. Brief events between samples may be missed.

minGapSec.description: Changes mode only: minimum seconds between selected changes, default 1.

maxSize.description: Long-edge pixel cap for every frame; omit to use the configured value.

quality.description: JPEG quality for this call; omit to use the configured value.

summary.zh: 按时间或画面变化抽取视频帧，返回带时间戳的 JPEG。变化检测支持阈值、扫描帧率和最小时间间隔。
summary.en: Extract timestamped JPEGs by time or visual change, with a change threshold, scan frame rate and minimum spacing.

tools.name: frame_config
tools.description: Read or change the default extraction settings: frames, maxFrames, maxSize, quality, timeoutMs. status shows the current values; set saves the given keys to the config. Arguments passed to frame_extract override these for one call.

action.description: status = show the current settings; set = save the given keys.

maxFrames.description: The most frames one call may take.

summary.zh: 查看或修改默认取帧设置（帧数、单次上限、长边、JPEG 质量、超时）；改动写入配置。引擎路径只在配置页改。
summary.en: Read or change the default extraction settings (frame count, cap, long edge, JPEG quality, timeout); set saves them to the config. Engine paths are operator-only.

tools.name: frame_search
tools.description: Search a local video or animated image with a text query. Supports multilingual queries, including Chinese. Builds a persistent sampled-frame embedding index on first use and reuses it for later queries. First use may download required resources; media and queries are processed locally. Returns highest cosine-similarity frames in rank order with timestamps and JPEG attachments. Scores are not probabilities and a high rank does not prove an event occurred. Short events between samples can be missed; inspect nearby times with frame_extract. The receipt reports coverage and indexId; frame_index lists or deletes cached indexes.

source.description: Local video/image path or log:/mem: handle, as in frame_extract.

query.description: Visual content to retrieve; supports Chinese and other languages, e.g. 红色汽车 or a person entering a room.

frames.description: Maximum search results, default 4; also limited by maxFrames.

intervalSec.description: Target index sampling interval in seconds. Defaults to semanticIntervalSec; the index cap may reduce density across the full range.

start.description: Indexed range start in seconds, default 0.

end.description: Indexed range end in seconds, default the clip duration.

minGapSec.description: Minimum seconds between returned matches, default 1.

minScore.description: Optional cosine similarity floor. No universal threshold guarantees a match.

summary.zh: 按文字检索视频帧，支持中文等多语言；首次建立索引，后续查询复用，返回时间戳、相似度和图片。
summary.en: Search video frames with text in Chinese and other languages. Reuse cached indexes and return ranked timestamps, similarities and JPEGs.

tools.name: frame_index
tools.description: List or delete persistent semantic video indexes. list reports indexId, source, frame count and creation time. delete removes one index and its sampled JPEGs; downloaded search resources are retained. Indexes are built automatically by frame_search.

indexId.description: Required for delete. Copy the full indexId from frame_search or frame_index list.

summary.zh: 列出或删除语义检索索引及其采样帧；保留已下载的检索资源。
summary.en: List or delete semantic indexes and their sampled frames; retain downloaded search resources.

changelog.0.2.0:
- 新增 `semanticPreset` 配置，提供默认的 `CLIP-CPU` 和 `Gemma2-GPU`。首次使用时加载并复用模型；推理请求排队，切换预设或停用 World 时释放原进程。不同模型分别缓存索引。
- Add default `CLIP-CPU` and optional `Gemma2-GPU` search presets with resident models, queued inference and model-specific indexes. Switching presets or stopping the World releases the previous worker.

- 进度消息由调用方明确订阅，避免运行中的工具把更新后的子进程进度误作结果；校验查询和全部采样帧的向量后才保存索引。
- Require explicit progress subscription for worker compatibility and validate query and frame vectors before saving an index.

- 检索状态与日志显示资源准备、下载、采样和画面分析进度；下载连接或传输停滞时返回失败。
- Show resource preparation, downloads, sampling and frame analysis in search status and logs; fail stalled download connections and transfers.

- 新增「工具」页：查看与编辑四个工具及参数说明，支持筛选、保存、单字段或全部恢复默认，以及未保存修改提示。覆盖按 bot 包和部署分层，保存时检查版本；不改变参数约束和执行行为。
- Add a Tools page for filtering and editing tool/schema text, restoring inherited defaults and protecting unsaved or concurrent edits. Overrides are scoped to the bot package and deployment; execution contracts remain unchanged.

- `frame_extract` 新增 `mode: "changes"`：本地 ffmpeg 扫描画面变化，支持阈值、扫描帧率、时间范围和最小时间间隔；回执显示时间戳与变化分数。
- `frame_search` 按文字检索视频帧，支持中文等多语言；按视频内容与采样设置缓存索引，后续查询复用图像向量。
- `frame_index` 列出或删除索引和采样帧。检索资源首次使用时自动下载到扩展数据目录，可关闭下载以离线运行；检索支持取消与超时。
- `frame_extract` adds local ffmpeg change detection with thresholds, scan rate, time ranges, spacing and change scores.
- `frame_search` adds local multilingual text-to-frame retrieval with reusable image embeddings; `frame_index` lists and deletes indexes. Required resources download automatically on first use. Downloads are configurable, and searches support cancellation and deadlines.
changelog.0.1.0:
- 首个版本：`frame_extract` 工具，接受本地视频 / 动图路径或 `log:` / `mem:` 句柄，用本机 ffmpeg 拆成 JPEG 帧，作为图片附件交回模型。
- 三种取样方式：均匀取 `frames` 帧（默认）、每 `interval` 秒一帧、按 `times` 指定时间点；`start` / `end` 限定范围。
- 每帧的时间写进回执、图片文件名与附件说明；`maxSize` 限制长边，`quality` 控制 JPEG 质量。
- 新增 `frame_config` 工具：桌宠可以查看或修改默认帧数、单次上限、长边、质量与超时，改动写入配置；ffmpeg / ffprobe 路径只在配置页改，桌宠不能把引擎指向任意程序。
- 没有 npm 运行时依赖；本机需要 `ffmpeg` 与 `ffprobe`。取帧可被 interrupt 取消，句柄临时文件与帧目录在调用结束后删除。
